issue.detail: Spec says synchronous reset but does not specify whether reset has priority over load when r==1 and d changes; contract gives R1 priority 1, but alternative could be load priority.
issue.spec_evidence: active high synchronous reset (reset output to 0)
issue.alternative: Reset and load both active on same posedge; load d takes priority over reset, so q follows d when r==1.

issue.detail: Spec does not define initial q before first posedge; contract says unspecified, but alternative could be q=0 initially.
issue.spec_evidence: Implement a simple D flip flop
issue.alternative: Initial q is 0 before any clock edge.
